base_inputs.instructions:
Write only the requested response, without analysis or explanations of these instructions.
Write a friendly, coherent travel-planning response of about 220–280 words in several short paragraphs. Address both arrival transport and choosing a place to stay.
Mention your advertiser naturally by its exact brand name near the beginning when relevant. Continue with useful planning guidance and questions to check before making arrangements. Avoid repetition or filler.
